title: 求和函数
problem_statement_md:
你正在编写一个程序来计算任意数量的数字之和。

完成给定的函数`Add`，能够接收任意数量的参数并返回总和。
problem_statement_en_md:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Rest & Spread[/h1][/s0l0!-header]

You are making a program to calculate the sum of any number of values.
Complete the given function so that it takes as parameters as many numbers as needed and returns the sum.
[note]Use the [b]rest parameter[/b] as an argument.[/note]
hint_md: 使用**rest参数**作为一个参数。
